output.reason: The CR-118 config change fits the initial evidence: it was the only change touching NSP-02, the pay errors hit only the premium, and the hours were right. The brief also backs it with a full recalculation and a test re-run, though one thing jars: it counts 147 underpaid but says only 8 raised no ticket, when there were 139 tickets.
